issues.reason: The subject is the explicit member-reaching wording the collective-noun rule names ("the crew members" / "every member of the crew"), so putting the collective in Holder asserts that the team as a unit holds the shares — a claim the text does not make about the team.

The conflation half stands — a collective noun "already names the kind, so 'the committee' needs no GroupOf", and this atom was serving as the missing subject group — but the atom itself is vacuously true rather than false, so it is redundancy, not a falsehood.

Categorical statements: a definite plural "picks out specific things, so it takes a group witness — (GroupOf <group> <kind>)"; (Member sk_shares_1 share) instead types the plural referent as one individual share.

Mistakes the reviewer's own gap for a defect: the RestOf form is specced over "what is left after a mentioned part" and needs a whole symbol the text never supplies, and "remaining" is a property of the collection itself (the licensed exception to the distributive rule), so the atom is true and well-typed.

gaps_confirmed: "the remaining X" with no antecedent whole in the text — the Partitives RestOf/SubsetOf form needs a mentioned whole to point at

a proper-noun modifier inside a compound NP ("the QVC management team") — Compound concepts explicitly does not apply to proper nouns, so the part-whole route to (PartOf sk_team_1 qvc) is improvisation
new_gaps: a bare-plural relational-noun subject restricted by "of the" ("Members of the QVC management team") has no designated encoding — Partitives require a cardinal or non-universal proportional amount, and the explicit-universal route requires every/each/all
repair_summary: Minted the subject group sk_group_1 with (GroupOf sk_group_1 member) + (PartOf sk_group_1 sk_team_1) ("member of a group" is one of PartOf's two stated jobs) and moved Holder onto it; dropped the vacuous (GroupOf sk_team_1 member) that was standing in for it; changed (Member sk_shares_1 share) to (GroupOf sk_shares_1 share) for the definite plural.
notes: (Member sk_shares_1 remaining) is left untouched per the refuted issue 3. Holder for "hold shares" is the possession sense the role is reserved for, so the stative-transitive-Agent line does not reach it.
